name: List
description: Composable stack of repeated rows for queues, settings, files, activity, and compact summaries.
import: import { List, ListItem, ListItemLeading, ListItemContent, ListItemTitle, ListItemDescription, ListItemMeta, ListItemActions } from "@/components/ui/list"

List.description: Root stack for repeated list items.

render.description: Optional Base UI render prop for polymorphic output.

className.description: Additional classes for the list root.

ListItem.description: Single row with optional leading content, main content, metadata, and actions.

variant.description: Visual weight of the row surface.

interactive.description: Adds pointer, hover, and focus treatment for clickable rows.

selected.description: Marks the row as the current selected item.

disabled.description: Dims the row and disables pointer interaction.

render.description: Optional Base UI render prop for links, buttons, or custom elements.

ListItemLeading.description: Icon, avatar, number, or compact status block at the start of a row.

tone.description: Soft token color for the leading block.

className.description: Additional classes for the leading slot.
Additional classes for the content area.

forbidden: Do not use List for comparable tabular data; use Table.
Do not use List for one standalone content block; use Card.
Do not put independent cards inside list rows.
Do not rely on hover alone for selection; use selected for current rows.

responsive.note: Compact rows keep a 44px minimum height. Actions should stay reachable on mobile.
